supportbundle.screen.title: SupportBundle
supportbundle.configuration.title: %s Configuration
supportbundle.configuration.gui.tooltip: Options for the SupportBundle screen and pause menu integration.
supportbundle.configuration.message.tool: Options for the copied support message.
supportbundle.configuration.reports.tool: Options for report files and storage.
supportbundle.configuration.collection.t: Options that decide which diagnostic data goes into a report.
supportbundle.configuration.privacy.tool: Options that control personal or environment details in reports.
supportbundle.configuration.links.toolti: Options for support links shown in the report screen.
supportbundle.configuration.gui.title: Screen Title
supportbundle.configuration.gui.title.to: Title shown at the top of the report screen.
supportbundle.configuration.gui.instruct: Short instruction text shown on the report screen.
supportbundle.configuration.gui.showPaus: Show a SupportBundle button in the pause screen.
supportbundle.configuration.message.temp: Text copied by the Discord/GitHub message button. Available variables: {minecraft_version}, {neoforge_version}, {modpack}, {report_file}.
supportbundle.configuration.reports.fold: Folder under the game directory where report zip files are written.
supportbundle.configuration.reports.zipP: Filename prefix used for report zip files.
supportbundle.configuration.controls.ena: Allow the SupportBundle key mapping to open the report screen.
supportbundle.configuration.collection.l: Include a sanitized tail of logs/latest.log when it exists.
Maximum latest.log tail size in KiB.
supportbundle.configuration.collection.c: Include the newest sanitized crash report when one exists.
supportbundle.configuration.collection.k: Include key mappings that share the same assigned key.
supportbundle.configuration.collection.a: Extra text files to include from the game directory. Each entry must be a relative path without '..'. Files are sanitized before they are added.
supportbundle.configuration.privacy.incl: Include the current multiplayer server address. Disabled by default for privacy.
Include the current account name. Disabled by default for privacy.
Include operating system and Java runtime information.
supportbundle.configuration.privacy.extr: Additional regular expressions replaced with [redacted] in collected text.
supportbundle.configuration.links.suppor: Optional support page URL shown in the report screen.
supportbundle.configuration.links.issueT: Optional issue tracker URL shown in the report screen.
supportbundle.configuration.links.discor: Optional Discord URL shown in the report screen.
supportbundle.configuration.links.showIn: Show configured support links in the report screen.
